basic_details.job_title: BHU Young Professional Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 4 Posts
basic_details.short_information: The Institute of Agricultural Sciences, Banaras Hindu University (BHU), Varanasi, invites applications for 4 temporary posts of Young Professional-I and Young Professional-II across research projects funded by the U.P. Council of Agricultural Research, Lucknow, for a period of 03 years. The posts offer a consolidated monthly fellowship of Rs. 30,000 for Young Professional-I (requiring a 4-year B.Sc. Ag.) and Rs. 42,000 for Young Professional-II (requiring an M.Tech or PG degree in Food Technology, Dairy Technology, or related disciplines). Candidates may apply by submitting their application o

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Eligibility requirements for each post, including essential qualifications, desirable qualifications, and upper age limits, are outlined below: Serial No. 1, 2, 4 (YP-I): 28 years Serial No. 3 (YP-II): 30 years 5 years: For female, SC, ST, and Physically Handicapped candidates 3 years: For OBC candidates Candidates should verify discipline-specific eligibility requirements directly from the official notification.

rows.desirable_qualification: Candidates with minimum two years experience in field experimentation, having proven computer and statistical knowledge

rows.essential_qualification: M.Tech/PG degree in Food Technology /Dairy Technology/ Dairy Science/Dairy Chemistry/Dairy Microbiology/Dairy Engineering/Food Science/Livestock Product Technology
rows.desirable_qualification: Ph.D. in relevant discipline/NET qualified, with good publication record

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Selected candidates will receive a consolidated monthly salary/fellowship as prescribed below: The engagement is purely temporary and co-terminus with the project for an approved duration of 03 years.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for BHU Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Prepare an application on plain paper giving Name, Permanent and correspondence Address, Name of Father and Mother, Telephone no., and e-mail address. Include complete details of your educational career starting from High School or equivalent examination. Attach attested copies of all mark-sheets and certificates. Enclose details of any research or other relevant experience, if applicable. Send a soft copy of the completed application along with attachments to the respective Principal Investigator's email address on or before the date of interview. Submit a hard copy of the application along with all attested documents to the respective Principal Investigator on or before the interview date, or submit it at the time of interview at 11:00 AM on 30 October 2026.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Selection will be made on the basis of a walk-in interview. The interview details are as follows: Date of Interview: 30 October 2026 (Friday) Time: 11:00 AM Venue: Committee room No -1, Institute of Agricultural Sciences, Banaras Hindu University, Varanasi Travel Allowance: No TA/DA will be paid if called for interview.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The positions are purely temporary and co-terminus with the projects funded by U.P. Council of Agricultural Research, Lucknow, for a duration of 03 years. No TA/DA will be provided for attending the walk-in interview. Applications must include attested copies of mark-sheets and educational certificates from High School onward. Candidates must ensure that soft copies reach the concerned Principal Investigator's email on or before the interview date. Hard copies of the application and supporting certificates can be submitted either prior to the interview date or at the venue at 11:00 AM on 30 October 2026.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are available in BHU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 4 vacancies: 3 posts for Young Professional-I and 1 post for Young Professional-II.

faq.question: Q2. When and where will the walk-in interview be held?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will take place at 11:00 AM on 30 October 2026 at Committee room No -1, Institute of Agricultural Sciences, Banaras Hindu University, Varanasi.

faq.question: Q3. What is the essential educational qualification for Young Professional-I?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a B.Sc. Ag. (4 years) degree.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification for Young Professional-II?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an M.Tech or PG degree in Food Technology, Dairy Technology, Dairy Science, Dairy Chemistry, Dairy Microbiology, Dairy Engineering, Food Science, or Livestock Product Technology.

faq.question: Q5. What is the upper age limit for the Young Professional posts?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 28 years for Young Professional-I (Serial Nos. 1, 2, and 4) and 30 years for Young Professional-II (Serial No. 3).

faq.question: Q6. What age relaxations are provided for reserved categories?
faq.answer: A relaxation of 5 years is granted to female, SC, ST, and Physically Handicapped candidates, while 3 years is provided for OBC candidates.

faq.question: Q7. What is the consolidated salary for Young Professional posts?
faq.answer: Young Professional-I receives a consolidated pay of Rs. 30,000 per month, and Young Professional-II receives Rs. 42,000 per month.

faq.question: Q8. Is the BHU Young Professional position permanent or temporary?
faq.answer: The appointment is purely temporary and co-terminus with the project for a period of 03 years.

faq.question: Q9. How should candidates submit their application?
faq.answer: Candidates must apply on plain paper and send a soft copy to the respective Principal Investigator's email, along with submitting a hard copy on or before the interview date or at the time of interview on 30 October 2026.

faq.question: Q10. What documents must be submitted along with the application?
faq.answer: Candidates must attach attested copies of all mark-sheets and certificates starting from High School or equivalent, along with details of any research or other experience.
